wikiResults.title: Scholar
wikiResults.extract: Scholar is a categorization for the three spell-casting professions. Being the most lightly armored, these professions are considered to fill traditional backline roles, but can also use martial weapons and can be built to be extremely efficient in close range combat. All scholars are practitioners and students of magic, an ancient art with which many are gifted, and which varies from control over life and death to manipulation of others and command over forces of nature itself.

wikiResults.extract: Underground Scholar is part of the personal story of norn characters who chose to side with the Durmand Priory in the previous mission.

wikiResults.title: Scholar Mossi
wikiResults.extract: Scholar Mossi is an asura found standing next to Grandmaster Craftsman Hobbs, wielding Astralaria and HOPE, that offers certain collectibles to complete the second tier of precursor crafting.

wikiResults.title: Scholar Glenna
wikiResults.extract: Scholar Glenna is a Durmand Priory scholar, who serves as a vendor for Magnetite Shards in every raid. The associated raid encounter must be completed before you can buy its items from her. She also offers to buy any raid-themed miniature for 40 Magnetite Shards.

wikiResults.extract: WvW Fall Tournament 2014 is the third WvW tournament for Guild Wars 2; it lasts four weeks beginning September 12, 2014 and continuing through October 10, 2014. wikiResults.title: Shadow of the Mad King (achievements)
wikiResults.extract:
Shadow of the Mad King is a holiday achievement category for the Shadow of the Mad King release that celebrates Halloween in Tyria. Each achievement in this category can only be completed once per account. As such, this category may have already been completed for subsequent years.
It contains the achievements related to Magister Tassi's investigation of the Mad King's past and the acquisition of the Mad Memoires backpieces.

wikiResults.title: Jormag Rising (achievements)
wikiResults.extract: Jormag Rising is an achievement category for the achievements earned during the Jormag Rising story and within Drizzlewood Coast.

wikiResults.title: Shadow of the Mad King (achievements)
wikiResults.extract:
Shadow of the Mad King is a holiday achievement category for the Shadow of the Mad King release that celebrates Halloween in Tyria. Each achievement in this category can only be completed once per account. As such, this category may have already been completed for subsequent years.
It contains the achievements related to Magister Tassi's investigation of the Mad King's past and the acquisition of the Mad Memoires backpieces.

wikiResults.title: Master Aspect Gatherer
wikiResults.extract:
Master Aspect Gatherer is an achievement during Festival of the Four Winds that requires players to find ten Master Sky Crystals throughout Labyrinthine Cliffs.
Note that after you interact with the Sky Crystals, there's no way to tell whether it was a Master Sky Crystal or a regular Sky Crystal. You'll probably want to reference the Aspect Gatherer page along with this one.

wikiResults.title: Aspect Gatherer
wikiResults.extract:
Aspect Gatherer is an achievement during Festival of the Four Winds that requires players to find 52 Sky Crystals throughout Labyrinthine Cliffs.
Note that the collected crystals do not display an object name and have no interact option. After you interact with the Sky Crystals, there's no way to tell whether it was a regular Sky Crystal (this achievement) or Master Sky Crystal (see Master Aspect Gatherer) other than the achievement user interface.

wikiResults.title: Unintended Coursework
wikiResults.extract: Unintended Coursework is a Super Adventure Box achievement, requiring the player to find a glitch in each of the Super Adventure Box zones. Destroying a glitch will spawn a Glitched Chest at the end of the zone, for a max of 6 chests per day. The chests can be opened once per day per zone, in any mode.
